source.title: Can we fix inscriptions milling ability?
source.author: Errtu-2443806

quote: instead of having five I need 10
inputName: One Midnight herb type; quality rank unspecified
notes: Original player says the profession panel showed 17 possible mills across a fragmented inventory, but the player could not start milling because there were fewer than 10 of any one herb type. Seventeen is an interface capacity indicator, NOT 17 completed casts. Individual herb/output item IDs, actual casts, quantity, ranks, profession skill, specialization and build are unknown. This independently supports 10 of one herb type per mill; no empirical drop data.

source.title: Is "Perfect Milling" intended to be a trap?
source.author: bjm-2732848

quote: technically possible to mill a mix of ranks if you have fewer than 10 of one rank in your inventory
inputName: One Midnight herb type; mixed quality ranks when inventory forces selection
notes: Original Sep 26 forum commenter reports a UI-dependent way to mill mixed quality ranks of one herb when fewer than 10 of an individual rank are held; not a controlled at-cast experiment and no exact split between ranks was shown. In same thread tuxedobob reports 24/30 Perfect Milling knowledge, +40 tools, high-rank pigment from high-rank herbs before those points, and personally estimated skill 505 needed versus projected 455; these are unverified estimates and observations, NOT thresholds to encode, measured output, or yield confidence. No output rank/item ID, actual cast count or histogram. Does NOT establish mixing different herb types.
